title: My Friend Anna
text:
My friend Anna has long brown hair and green eyes. She is tall and very friendly. She has a small red bicycle that she rides to school every day.

Her house is blue with a big white door. There is a large garden with many yellow flowers. Anna likes to sit under a tree and read books.

questions.text: What can we infer about Anna from the passage?
options: She is shy and does not talk to people
She has never been to school

questions.text: Why might Anna ride her bicycle to school?
options: It is a fast and easy way to travel
She does not like her school
Her house is in another country

vocabulary.definition: kind and nice to other people
a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pedalling
an area with plants and grass around a house

paragraph_translations: Moja przyjaciółka Anna ma długie brązowe włosy i zielone oczy. Jest wysoka i bardzo przyjazna. Ma mały czerwony rower, którym codziennie jeździ do szkoły.
Jej dom jest niebieski z dużymi białymi drzwiami. Jest tam duży ogród z wieloma żółtymi kwiatami. Anna lubi siedzieć pod drzewem i czytać książki.
